description: This file defines the ActivitiesRelationship class, which manages metadata and relationships for a specific type of one-to-many relationship within the SuiteCRM system. It extends the OneToManyRelationship class, providing methods for building labels, vardefs, subpanel and relationship metadata, specifically for activity-related modules.

classes.name: ActivitiesRelationship
classes.description: A class extending OneToManyRelationship to manage 'Activities'-related one-to-many relationships, including building labels, vardefs, subpanel configurations, and relationship metadata specific to activity modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the relationship with a given definition by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: buildLabels
methods.description: Generates display labels for the relationship, avoiding duplicates, and incorporating module labels and translations.

methods.name: buildVardefs
methods.description: Builds vardef definitions for the related modules, creating link fields based on the relationship.

methods.name: getLinkFieldDefinition
methods.description: Creates a link field definition array for a given source module and relationship, used in vardef creation.

methods.name: buildFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Determines which fields to add to module layouts for this relationship.

methods.name: buildSubpanelDefinitions
methods.description: Generates subpanel definitions for the activities and history modules, ensuring they're added only once per module.

methods.name: buildRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Creates metadata definitions for the relationship, including key attributes and relationship type.

methods.name: buildActivitiesSubpanelDefinition
methods.description: Constructs a subpanel configuration for activities collection, including top buttons and module data.

methods.name: buildHistorySubpanelDefinition
methods.description: Constructs a subpanel configuration for historical data, including buttons and related modules.
